verdict.rationale: AngelList documents an Open Cap Table Format (OCF) export of the cap table and Excel exports of many reports. The help center also describes a supported transition path to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), and community users describe a self-serve account deletion flow, so the core of 'export in open formats and leave' is covered for cap table data. However, nothing shows a complete export of all account data, such as uploaded agreements, board consents, signed documents and stakeholder records, and no export API is evidenced. Missing for 10: full-account bulk export covering documents and non-cap-table data, a programmatic or API export path, and independent hands-on confirmation that the OCF export is complete and portable.
